sloka: तच्छैलशृङ्गं सहसा विशीर्णं भुजान्तरे तस्य तदा विशाले।ततो विषेदुः सहसा प्लवङ्गा रक्षोगणाश्चापि मुदा विनेदुः ।। ६.६७.६१ ।।
transliteration: tacchailaśṛṅgaṁ sahasā viśīrṇaṁ bhujāntare tasya tadā viśāle।tato viṣeduḥ sahasā plavaṅgā rakṣogaṇāścāpi mudā vineduḥ ।। 6.67.61 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words, Sugriva forcibly discharged a mountain resembling a thunderbolt on the chest of Kumbhakarna.
